desc: Derive the two-layer state graph: original mode uses outgoing edges, reversed mode uses incoming edges, and each vertex has a mode-toggle edge of cost X.
Verify that every global reversal is represented exactly by toggling the orientation state at the current vertex.
Choose an implicit adjacency representation with forward and reverse edge lists.
Implement Dijkstra with Python integers and a heap priority queue; output min(dist[N][0], dist[N][1]).
Run against all provided samples and confirm `O((N + M) log N)` complexity.
